description: DiligenceOps: submit a shipping promise (as quoted text or as dispatch time, delivery window, delivery-by date, cost and free-shipping threshold) and the delivery evidence (order, dispatch and delivery dates or tracking events, the shipping charge and order total). The signed report computes each deadline in calendar or business days and lists the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches with the days late and the amount over. POST /api/shipping-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

as_of.description: When the evidence was gathered. Defaults to the check time.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

delivered_at.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

dispatched_at.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

events.description: Tracking events. Dispatch and delivery dates are read from them when the fields are absent.

at.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

status.description: The tracking event as recorded, for example "Picked up by carrier" or "Delivered".

order_total.description: Order total, for a free-shipping threshold.

ordered_at.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

label.description: Optional name for the order or seller, recorded in the report.

promise.description: The shipping promise as quoted text, as fields, or both. Fields take precedence over the text.

cost.description: Promised shipping cost; 0 for free shipping.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

delivery_by.description: A delivery date the seller promised.

delivery_within.description: Delivery window after the order, for example {min: 3, max: 5, unit: "business_days"}.

free_over.description: Order total at or above which shipping is promised free.

text.description: The promise as quoted, for example "Ships within 1 business day. Delivery in 3-5 business days. Free shipping on orders over $50."

name: wever_shipping-check
title: Shipping check
